channel.title: AI Threat Watch: ID
channel.description: Verified case files located in ID.

item.title: [HIGH] Indonesia and Malaysia block Grok after it produced sexualised images of women and minors
item.description: Indonesia temporarily blocked xAI's Grok on 10 January 2026 and Malaysia followed on 11 January. Both cited repeated use of the tool to make non-consensual sexual images from real photos, including of minors. Target: Women and minors whose photos were edited by Grok. ID. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [LOW] Indonesian police arrest three over TikTok deepfake of governor selling Rp500k motorbikes
item.description: Three men from Pangandaran edited videos of Governor Khofifah with AI to advertise a fake programme offering motorbikes for Rp500,000, taking about Rp87 million from roughly 100 victims before arrest. Target: Indonesian TikTok users; Governor Khofifah Indar Parawansa. ID. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Indonesian police arrest two over deepfake videos of President Prabowo promising cash aid
item.description: Indonesian police arrested suspects AMA and JS for spreading AI videos of President Prabowo, VP Gibran and Minister Sri Mulyani offering aid for admin fees; about Rp 95 million (about $5,800) taken from 100-plus victims. Target: Indonesian social media users across 20 provinces. ID. Verification: confirmed.
